title: 地域政策学Ⅱ
subtitle: Social Project Management II
keywords: Asset management and risk management 2.Highway projects 3.Disaster recovery and reconstruction projects 4.Special projects (power generation projects, etc.)
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) gain an overview of asset management and risk management. (2) learn procedures for highway projects. (3) learn about disaster recovery and reconstruction projects. (4) learn about special projects (power generation projects, etc.).
advice: This course deals with the management of social construction projects. We will cover the following topics: 1. Overview of asset management and risk management. 2. Highway projects: planning, design, construction, maintenance, and management. 3. Disaster recovery and reconstruction projects. 4. Special projects (power generation projects, etc.). Precautions The lectures listed above are delivered as special presentations by invited professional engineers involved in each project. Students are required to actively participate in class. The schedule of the special lectures is subject to change. Reference documents and practice problems will be distributed to students as appropriate.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of civil engineering, engineering ethics.
